scope: Post-hoc read-only review of completed episodes only, while fixed study continues. No feedback injected into researcher prompts, no new model requests or GPU executions.

rows.rationale:
Abalone rings regression: group-aware stacked ensemble.

Rationale (exploratory, validated only by internal group CV):
The common reference is a single ExtraTreesRegressor (dev MSE 4.677).  Abalone
ring counts are noisy and heteroscedastic; single fully-grown tree ensembles
overfit local structure and mis-handle the heavy upper tail.  This method
(1) adds physically meaningful derived features (weight ratios, "dried/other"
weight residual, volume and densities, log and cube-root scalings),
(2) trains a diverse pool of base learners with different inductive biases
(two histogram GBMs, a Poisson-loss GBM, log-target GBM, ExtraTrees, RF,
degree-2 polynomial RidgeCV, kNN, RBF-SVR, MLP),
(3) blends them with non-negative least squares plus a free intercept fitted on
out-of-fold predictions generated with GroupKFold over api.train_groups, so the
blend weights estimate the declared new-group generalization task rather than
in-sample fit.
Non-negative weights with an intercept act as a shrinkage/recalibration step,
which typically buys a few percent MSE over any single member.

Limitations: weights are fitted on ~2.3k training rows with a modest number of
groups, so blend weights carry sampling noise; CV MSE reported in findings is an
internal estimate, not an independent measurement on development/audit data.

limitations: OOF MSE is an internal group-CV estimate on training rows only; it is not a measurement on development or audit data.
Blend weights are fitted on the same OOF predictions used to report blend MSE, so the reported blend MSE is mildly optimistic.
No development labels were used anywhere in this method.

confirmation.uncertainty_note: Paired group bootstrap, descriptive rather than a finite-sample guarantee.

rows.rationale:
CIFAR-100 (12k-image subset) method.

Rationale (exploratory, measured only by the reported holdout numbers below):
The common reference is a ResNet-9 trained ~100 epochs with (a) a *single* crop
offset shared by the whole mini-batch, (b) no cutout/mixup, (c) no ensembling.
On a 12k-image subset of CIFAR-100 the dominant error source is overfitting plus
under-trained schedules, so this method changes three things that are cheap in
wall time on an A100:

1. Per-sample augmentation: per-image random translation (reflect-pad 4, gathered
   crop), per-image horizontal flip (allowed for CIFAR), per-image cutout (8x8,
   p=0.5) and batch-level mixup (alpha=0.2, p=0.5) with label smoothing 0.1.
2. A slightly wider ResNet-9 (64/128/256/512, three residual pairs, avg+max
   concat head) trained with SGD+Nesterov, warmup + cosine, bf16 autocast,
   channels_last, all data resident on GPU -> a few hundred epochs per model
   inside the budget instead of ~100.
3. A 3-model seed ensemble with horizontal-flip test-time augmentation
   (softmax averaging).

Validation: groups from api.train_groups are split so that model 0 never sees a
held-out group; its holdout accuracy is an unbiased single-model estimate.
Models 1 and 2 use all training rows, so the reported *ensemble* holdout number
is optimistic and is labelled as such in the findings.

measured_findings.limitations: Models 1-2 trained on all rows including the holdout group, so the ensemble holdout accuracy is optimistic; only model 0 is unbiased. No development labels were used. Epoch counts are wall-time limited on a shared GPU, so the schedule length can vary between runs.
measured_findings.augmentation: per-sample pad4 crop + hflip + cutout8(p=0.5) + mixup(a=0.2,p=0.5), ls=0.1

observations: Abalone-0 control executed eight-fold grouped CV and a heterogeneous nonnegative blend with derived physical features. All 2297 training feature groups were distinct.
Its 20.0339949% confirmation gain did not establish the final target: audit gain was 9.7948038%, below the frozen 10% floor despite a negative paired uncertainty bound.
The observed gap does not by itself identify overfitting, random sample variation or population shift as its cause.
The unused proposal followed a terminal rejected audit; unused_after_delivery does not imply successful delivery.
The AG News control liblinear multiclass error is an implementation failure in this runtime, distinct from a negative method result.
